name: Francofil
summary: French filament maker in Normandy, founded in 2017 by Florent Port, that extrudes PLA, ABS, ASA, PETG, PETG-CF, TPU and TPE. It is known for recycled and upcycled materials, including recycled PP and ABS resin from Veolia and PLA filled with coffee grounds or slate-quarry waste, and makes custom filaments for clients.

additional_notes: Veolia supplies recycled PP and coloured ABS resin that Francofil extrudes (confirmed by Nextmove). That is a raw-material supply partnership, not an OEM relationship, so it is recorded here only. No link to any catalog OEM found. Member of the Mov'eo cluster.
